g.text: LAYOUT (section 8.5): TP8 on KA_N2 keeps ground around it. No pad on KA_N1.

g.desc: LAYOUT (section 8.5): TP8 on KA_N2 keeps ground around it. No pad on KA_N1.

g.text: Keep this pump (R29, C22, D7) at least 10 mm from the relay pump (R89, C51, D22).

g.desc: Keep this pump (R29, C22, D7) at least 10 mm from the relay pump (R89, C51, D22).

g.text: FAIL-SAFE GATE (hardware design section 8) and OVER-CURRENT LATCH (section 9).

g.desc: FAIL-SAFE GATE (hardware design section 8) and OVER-CURRENT LATCH (section 9).

g.text: Detector A. Firmware toggles KA (GPIO38) every 5 ms; an edge at least every 20 ms is needed.

g.desc: Detector A. Firmware toggles KA (GPIO38) every 5 ms; an edge at least every 20 ms is needed.

g.text: Each rising edge pushes charge through C22 and D7 into C23. R30 and R91 (two, so that one open

g.desc: Each rising edge pushes charge through C22 and D7 into C23. R30 and R91 (two, so that one open

g.text: resistor only doubles the hold-up) drain it. U6A switches on at 1.55 V on KA_N2 and off at 0.94 V

g.desc: resistor only doubles the hold-up) drain it. U6A switches on at 1.55 V on KA_N2 and off at 0.94 V

g.text: (R31, R32 hysteresis; reference 1.32 V from R34, R35). KA_OK is high 14 to 41 ms after the first

g.desc: (R31, R32 hysteresis; reference 1.32 V from R34, R35). KA_OK is high 14 to 41 ms after the first

g.text: edge and low 0.45 to 0.9 s after the last, 1.2 s if the pin stops high. A steady level, high or

g.desc: edge and low 0.45 to 0.9 s after the last, 1.2 s if the pin stops high. A steady level, high or

g.text: low, never enables it. R33 holds KA low while the ESP32 is in reset.

g.desc: low, never enables it. R33 holds KA low while the ESP32 is in reset.

g.text: DRV_EN = KA_OK AND NOT FAULT. Low does three things: Q3 removes V_DRV from every opto LED, the

g.desc: DRV_EN = KA_OK AND NOT FAULT. Low does three things: Q3 removes V_DRV from every opto LED, the

g.text: expander is held in reset, and the expander bit that drives relay transistor Q1 is released.

g.desc: expander is held in reset, and the expander bit that drives relay transistor Q1 is released.

g.text: DRV_EN_RB (through R92) lets firmware time detector A on GPIO42.

g.desc: DRV_EN_RB (through R92) lets firmware time detector A on GPIO42.

g.text: Over-current. U6B pulls OC_TRIP_N low above VH (1.425 V), U6C below VL (0.188 V): 4.6 A peak in

g.desc: Over-current. U6B pulls OC_TRIP_N low above VH (1.425 V), U6C below VL (0.188 V): 4.6 A peak in

g.text: either polarity, 4.0 to 5.4 A over tolerance, about 70 us after a short begins (R52, C33: 47 us).

g.desc: either polarity, 4.0 to 5.4 A over tolerance, about 70 us after a short begins (R52, C33: 47 us).

g.text: U7A and U7B latch it. D8 lights while FAULT is set. Only KA_OK going low clears the latch.

g.desc: U7A and U7B latch it. D8 lights while FAULT is set. Only KA_OK going low clears the latch.

g.text: R87 stops GPIO40 from overdriving the latch node if it is ever left as an output.

g.desc: R87 stops GPIO40 from overdriving the latch node if it is ever left as an output.

g.text: U7 is a 74HC132: Schmitt inputs for the slow edges of the open-collector comparators.

g.desc: U7 is a 74HC132: Schmitt inputs for the slow edges of the open-collector comparators.

g.text: Detector A: keep-alive edges on KA charge C23; U6A compares it with 1.32 V

g.desc: Detector A: keep-alive edges on KA charge C23; U6A compares it with 1.32 V
